dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, were you at home yesterday evening?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, wɜːr juː ət ˈhoʊm ˈjɛstərdeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I cooked dinner with my mom.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪ ˈkʊkt ˈdɪnər wɪð maɪ ˈmɑːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I watched a movie with Fah. We laughed a lot.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwɑːtʃt ə ˈmuːvi wɪð ˈfɑː. wiː ˈlæft ə ˈlɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, but it was sad, too. Fah cried!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt ɪt wʌz ˈsæd, ˈtuː. ˈfɑː ˈkraɪd!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I chatted with friends on the phone. I stayed up late!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈtʃætɪd wɪð ˈfrɛndz ɑːn ðə ˈfoʊn. aɪ ˈsteɪd ˈʌp ˈleɪt!
